Shaped iteration 0126 as one independent reviewer task in [tasks.json](tasks.json): `review-c1-challenges-0126`, default/high, 120 minutes and 100 turns.
Iteration 0125 accepted #597's new challenge package; its [procedure](../benchmark/writing/c1-challenges-0125.md) and [findings](../benchmark/writing/c1-challenges-0125-findings.md) identify the remaining independent usability and semantic checks.
The reviewer must save and hash source-derived atomic judgments before opening authored expectations, checker code, author code or recorded verification outcomes.
The task then compares expectations, preserves disagreements, checks procedure usability and reports separate Standards/Spec verdicts for this new scope.
Identity, source/package pins, model continuity and any premature exposure remain explicit; agreement with the author is not the acceptance criterion.
Detailed reviewer evidence belongs in session artifacts; the reviewer writes no repository review file.
Verification is the existing repository-only `python3 -I benchmark/writing/check_c1_challenges_0125.py`, inspected and run after independent judgments; it supplies no semantic or human approval.
I read the startup documents once, checked the history record and trusted author report, followed its procedure/findings links and read the evaluation and operating contracts.
Startup diagnostic was ok; graph readback confirmed the intended JSON fields, permitted role/model/effort, limits and empty dependency edges. No shell checks were available to this shaper.
Updated [working memory](../journal/working-memory.md) with the accepted package, evidence pins, new review scope and resume instructions.
Human C1 adjudication, native/trial evidence, general established-key use, benchmark readiness and owner method acceptance remain unresolved; no session can run LabVIEW.

## What next
Run the reviewer task. A later shaper should inspect its pinned findings, correct only named new-package defects if necessary, and preserve the exact artifacts through a permitted writer when needed. Close a CLEAR scope without repeating it; do not replay #594 or historical probes. Request #532 stays pending without duplication or waiting.
